about: Every tunable parameter of code-scrap. Viewers generate their settings panel from this file; presets override defaults by id. scope: viewer = applied by the viewer, server = sent to scrap via the options op.

settings.label: Theme
settings.desc: Look of panels and controls. Themes live in config/themes.

settings.label: Scale with display
settings.desc: Follow the operating system's display scale (DPI).

settings.label: Interface scale
settings.desc: Size of all panels, controls and text. Multiplies the display scale when scaling with the display.

settings.label: Mouse & keys
settings.desc: Navigation and shortcut scheme. Keymaps live in config/keymaps.

settings.label: Wheel zoom step
settings.desc: Zoom factor per wheel notch.

settings.label: Zoom smoothing
settings.desc: How fast the camera catches up with wheel zoom. Higher = snappier.

settings.label: Fly speed
settings.desc: Speed of animated flights (search hits, framing, home).

settings.label: Orbit speed
settings.desc: 3D rotation per pixel of mouse drag.

settings.label: Field of view
settings.desc: Vertical field of view of the 3D camera, in degrees.

settings.label: Fly to search results
settings.desc: Selecting a search result moves the camera to it. Off keeps the camera where it is.

settings.label: Label size
settings.desc: Font size of directory, file and scope labels in the viewport (before interface scale).

settings.label: Label budget
settings.desc: Most labels drawn at once; bigger boxes win.

settings.label: Smallest labelled box
settings.desc: Boxes narrower than this on screen get no label.

settings.label: Text blocks on screen
settings.desc: Most text blocks (file columns) drawn at once; the biggest on screen win.

settings.label: Show text from
settings.desc: Line height on screen (px) at which a file starts showing its line texture.

settings.label: Letters appear at
settings.desc: Line height (px) where dashes begin turning into letters.

settings.label: Letters complete at
settings.desc: Line height (px) where letters are fully shown.

settings.label: Letter weight
settings.desc: Glyph coverage curve: lower = bolder small text.

settings.label: Box outline
settings.desc: Width of box outlines in pixels (times interface scale). In 2D they snap to whole pixels, so every line has the same weight.

settings.label: Outline boxes from
settings.desc: Boxes smaller than this on screen (px) are drawn as solid cells without an outline.

settings.label: Nesting tone
settings.desc: How much lighter the fill of deeper-nested boxes gets, so nesting reads without relying on line weight.

settings.label: Selection outline
settings.desc: Width of the selection outline in pixels.

settings.label: Hover outline
settings.desc: Width of the hover outline in pixels.

settings.label: Selection
settings.desc: Outline and tint of the selected box.

settings.label: Hover
settings.desc: Outline of the box under the cursor.

settings.label: Search hits
settings.desc: Files and lines matching the current search.

settings.label: Imports
settings.desc: Arcs from the selection to what it imports.

settings.label: Imported by
settings.desc: Arcs from files that import the selection.

settings.label: Calls
settings.desc: Arcs from the selection to what it calls.

settings.label: Called by
settings.desc: Arcs from callers of the selection.

settings.label: Arc opacity
settings.desc: Strongest arc opacity; many arcs fade toward a fifth of it.

settings.label: Arc width (2D)
settings.desc: Arc line width in pixels on the flat map.

settings.label: 3D tile budget
settings.desc: Most map tiles drawn at once in the 3D city.

settings.label: Tile cache
settings.desc: Tiles kept in memory after they leave the view.

settings.label: Vendored
settings.desc: Area kept by third-party code checked into the repo (vendor/, third_party/, *.min.js …) when Importance is on.

settings.label: Tests
settings.desc: Area kept by tests, specs, fixtures and snapshots.

settings.label: Generated / minified
settings.desc: Area kept by files with very long lines.

settings.label: Assets
settings.desc: Area kept by images, fonts, media, archives, source maps and lockfiles.

settings.label: Data / config
settings.desc: Area kept by JSON, YAML, TOML and similar files.

settings.label: Diagnostics overlay
settings.desc: Frame time, tile and text streaming counters in the viewport corner (F12).

settings.label: Git history window
settings.desc: How far back git lenses look (git date syntax: 12.months, 2.years, 2025-01-01). Empty = whole history, which can take minutes on big repositories.
